# Response to RFQ VPK-2026-014 — Technical maintenance, warehouse and logistics properties

Visakoivu Oy

Visakoivu Oy is pleased to submit this quotation for the technical maintenance of your three warehouse and logistics properties, drawing on our existing experience with similar logistics and industrial clients across the Jyvaskyla region.

## Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds liability insurance well in excess of the EUR 1,000,000 threshold required, giving the buyer a comfortable margin above the minimum cover specified.

## Technical response

**Occupational safety plan.** A site-specific occupational safety plan is enclosed, covering the three warehouse and logistics properties and the hazards typical of that environment.

**Condition-monitoring data.** Measurements and observations from each maintenance visit are reported back to the buyer, giving visibility of equipment condition between visits rather than only at the point of a fault.

**Environmental matters.** Environmental matters — waste, hazardous substances, spill prevention — are managed in line with our standard procedures across all sites, with responsibility resting with the visiting technician at each site.

**Quality control and testing.** Work is delivered under our quality-control procedures, with testing carried out during maintenance visits and results recorded for the buyer's reference.

**Preventive maintenance plan.** A preventive maintenance plan is proposed for the systems covered by the contract, scheduling servicing ahead of likely fault points.

**Personnel qualifications.** Personnel working on site, including any subcontracted staff, hold the qualifications the work requires.

**Routine maintenance visits.** A routine maintenance visit schedule is proposed for the three sites, with the scope of each visit set out in advance.

**Service-level targets.** Service-level targets are proposed for each site, differentiated where warranted by site criticality.

## Commercial terms

The proposed contract period follows Section 1, with the extension option accepted. Our limitation-of-liability clause is enclosed. A bonus/malus arrangement is proposed against the service levels above. Pricing structure: fixed price, invoiced against the agreed schedule, with the total contract value set out in the accompanying price table.

## Format

Prices are quoted in EUR per square metre per year, not on a monthly basis, as required. Font size throughout is 11pt or larger. This document does not exceed 20 pages excluding appendices, in line with the page limit set out in the RFQ.

## Annex A — Technical specification

Fault reports outside normal working hours are covered by our standby (on-call) arrangement, with a technician reachable by phone throughout the covered hours.

Visakoivu Oy
